arxiv.metadata_rights: CC0; arXiv API terms explicitly separate descriptive metadata from e-print rights.
arxiv.content_rights: Per-paper license only; unknown unless observed. Private evidence; reference-only public citation.
arxiv.request_policy: One collector connection at a time; at least three seconds after the previous arXiv request completes. Controller serializes collector processes.

crossref.review_boundary: Crossref journal-article metadata alone is insufficient. Require the publisher's citation_article_type to be Article or Review; editorials, comments and inaccessible publisher metadata are ineligible.
crossref.publisher_redirect_boundary: Observed 2026-11-06: exact www.nature.com DOI article -> idp.nature.com/authorize -> /transit -> same article with cookies_not_supported. Only this parameter-validated anonymous round-trip is allowed; no cookies/credentials are stored or sent. Transient state/query identifiers never enter Candidate/SourceDocument URLs or revision hashes.
crossref.metadata_rights: Crossref metadata generally unrestricted; publisher abstracts may remain copyrighted.
crossref.content_rights: Record deposited license URL, content-version and start unchanged; do not infer permission or follow license URLs. Unknown/restrictive material remains reference-only.

engineering.authorship_boundary: Prefer explicit citation-author or structured Person credits. Parse only a bounded Written by name/team attribution; biographies and acknowledgment sentences are not authors. Unparseable person credits may use an explicitly supplied Organization author, never inferred people.
engineering.content_rights: Unknown unless article explicitly supplies rights evidence; repository licenses do not apply.
engineering.bootstrap_observation: Readable primary article redirects on the same official host to /research/multi-agent-research-system; published 2025-06-13, modified 2026-10-09. Historical backfill, not new publication.
